Compact tactical reset under Ludovic Magnin produces a hard-fought 1:1 stalemate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

spf.comment: Grasshoppers' aerial edge and squad continuity favor a home win, while their porous defense warrants double-chance draw protection.

score.comment: Primary 2:1 reflects Grasshoppers' physical superiority, while 1:1 accommodates a disciplined low block under Magnin.
